user_message: How should I wash and care for my graphic streetwear hoodie to keep the print intact?
assistant_reply: Hey! Welcome to RLVNT. I'm your AI customer assistant. All RLVNT pieces feature signature heavyweight cotton and relaxed streetwear silhouettes. Check our size chart for the perfect fit!

retrieved_sources.content:
Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Brand Governance | Section: Garment Care Standards
Recommended Garment Care for Print & Fabric Longevity: 1) Washing: Turn graphic crewnecks, hoodies, and jerseys inside-out. Machine wash cold (30°C max) on gentle cycle with similar colors. 2) Detergent: Use mild liquid detergent only. Never use chlorine bleach, harsh stain removers, or fabric softeners on prints. 3) Drying: Hang dry or lay flat in the shade. Avoid high-heat tumble drying to prevent cotton shrinkage and print cracking. 4) Ironing: Steam lightly or iron inside-out on low heat. Never press a hot iron directly onto printed artwork or embroidered badges. Damage resulting from improper washing, high-heat drying, bleaching, or direct ironing is not covered as a manufacturing defect.

Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Brand Governance | Section: Garment Care Standards
Recommended Garment Care for Print & Fabric Longevity: 1) Washing: Turn graphic crewnecks, hoodies, and jerseys inside-out. Machine wash cold (30°C max) on gentle cycle with similar colors. 2) Detergent: Use mild liquid detergent only. Never use chlorine bleach, harsh stain removers, or fabric softeners on prints. 3) Drying: Hang dry or lay flat in the shade. Avoid high-heat tumble drying to prevent cotton shrinkage and print cracking. 4) Ironing: Steam lightly or iron inside-out on low heat. Never press a hot iron directly onto printed artwork or embroidered badges. Damage resulting from improper washing, high-heat drying, bleaching, or direct ironing is not covered as a manufacturing defect.

Recommended Garment Care for Print & Fabric Longevity: 1) Washing: Turn graphic crewnecks, hoodies, and jerseys inside-out. user_message: How should I wash and care for my graphic streetwear hoodie to keep the print intact?
assistant_reply: Hey! Welcome to RLVNT. I'm your AI customer assistant. All RLVNT pieces feature signature heavyweight cotton and relaxed streetwear silhouettes. Check our size chart for the perfect fit!

retrieved_sources.content:
Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Brand Governance | Section: Garment Care Standards
Recommended Garment Care for Print & Fabric Longevity: 1) Washing: Turn graphic crewnecks, hoodies, and jerseys inside-out. Machine wash cold (30°C max) on gentle cycle with similar colors. 2) Detergent: Use mild liquid detergent only. Never use chlorine bleach, harsh stain removers, or fabric softeners on prints. 3) Drying: Hang dry or lay flat in the shade. Avoid high-heat tumble drying to prevent cotton shrinkage and print cracking. 4) Ironing: Steam lightly or iron inside-out on low heat. Never press a hot iron directly onto printed artwork or embroidered badges. Damage resulting from improper washing, high-heat drying, bleaching, or direct ironing is not covered as a manufacturing defect.

RLVNT pieces—including 100% cotton hoodies, heavyweight graphic crewnecks, vintage-cut jerseys, and wide-leg bottoms—are designed with relaxed streetwear proportions. Never press a hot iron directly onto printed artwork or embroidered badges. user_message: What is RLVNT's return window?
assistant_reply: Hey! Welcome to RLVNT. I'm your AI customer assistant. Returns and exchanges are accepted within 14 days of delivery for unworn garments with original tags attached. Exchange shipping is covered by the customer, while defective items are 100% covered by RLVNT.

retrieved_sources.content:
Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Brand Governance | Section: Resolution & Shipping Cost Matrix
1) Size or Style Exchange: Swap for another available size or equal-value item (or store credit if sold out). Return shipping is covered by the customer. 2) Defective or Wrong Item: Priority replacement with the correct item or full refund upon photo verification, with 100% of return shipping covered by RLVNT. 3) Standard Return / Refund: Refund issued to original payment method or store credit after warehouse inspection. Original and return shipping fees are non-refundable. 4) Non-Returnable Items: Final-sale clearance items, washed/altered garments, or items missing original tags.

Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Brand Governance | Section: Brand Identity & Positioning
RLVNT is a contemporary streetwear and apparel label built around bold visual culture, iconic sports and pop-culture references, and everyday oversized silhouettes. Every seasonal drop—including the signature Winter Collection—pairs expressive graphic storytelling with heavyweight comfort. Core brand pillars include Cultural Relevance, Unapologetic Visual Impact, Everyday Quality, and Transparent Service.

Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Brand Governance | Section: Inspection & Refund Processing
Returned parcels undergo quality inspection within 2-3 business days of arriving at our warehouse. Approved refunds are processed within 5-7 business days via original payment method or wallet store credit.

Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Brand Governance | Section: Product Architecture
RLVNT product architecture encompasses three primary categories: 1) Graphic Crewnecks & Hoodies: Heavyweight relaxed-fit tops crafted for cold-weather layering, including 100% cotton hoodies and high-contrast statement crewnecks. 2) Sports & Vintage-Inspired Tops: Football jerseys, half-zip pullovers, and retro-styled track jackets designed for casual street styling. 3) Bottoms & Full-Outfit Sets: Washed wide-leg denim, relaxed sweatpants, and coordinated monochrome sets.

The RLVNT Winter Collection showcases 9 signature statement crewnecks crafted from heavyweight cotton with high-contrast graphic storytelling. All tops feature relaxed streetwear fits.
